integrity: The primary open full text was inspected at the joint posterior, conditional posteriors in Eqs. (3.5)–(3.6), the normal-proposal discussion, and Algorithm 1 including Eq. (3.10). The Metropolis–Hastings comparison uses the classical target/proposal acceptance rule. The mathematical obstruction is a detailed-balance calculation, and a standalone checker was replayed from the packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the printed MCMC algorithm and does not determine which acceptance rule was used in unavailable numerical code.
It does not recompute all posterior point estimates or credible intervals.
A recent unindexed author correction could exist outside the sources examined.
title: The printed IPL Metropolis–Hastings step does not target its posterior
